about_the_game:
🎯 100 mischievous 🐱 cats are hiding and it's your mission to find them all! 🔍✨ Search every corner 🏠 and bring each scene 🎨 to life in a calm and relaxing environment 🌿🎶

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ❤️

🗺️ A beautifully hand-drawn map full of detail and charm ✏️🌸

🎨 Relax by coloring with guided numbers 🔢

🐱 100 hidden cats to discover 😻

🤝 Invite a friend to join your adventure online 🌍💌

🎵 Light lo-fi music 🎧 and ambient sounds 🌊 to boost your creativity 💡

🏆 Compete for rankings
